reason: Configures multiple OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway providers, discovers available models, manages route credentials, and supports ChatGPT OAuth through a DSH web settings panel.

summaries.zh: 通过 DSH 网页设置面板配置 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 网关、发现模型并管理路由凭据。
summaries.en: Configure OpenAI-compatible LLM gateways, discover models, and manage route credentials through a DSH web settings panel.

capabilities: Discovers models through gateway GET /models endpoints
Stores and reuses managed API credentials per route
Initiates ChatGPT OAuth for the openai-codex provider
Maps per-model reasoning and media input capabilities
